description:
## 1.0.0 (2026-11-10)

### ✨ New Features

* Gemini in Android work profiles with microG ([f752d4d](https://github.com/Johannes7k75/gemini-work-profile-patches/commit/f752d4d7197e6478920b027717a93907756e5efd))
* unlock chats that require an app update ([d879d78](https://github.com/Johannes7k75/gemini-work-profile-patches/commit/d879d7846296ec095b8567a22da52cd91d7aacea))

patches.name: Open cloned Google app
patches.description: Installs Gemini as a separate clone that opens the patched Google app (patch the Google app with this bundle too).

patches.name: Allow work profile
patches.description: Lets Gemini run in a work profile (Shelter, Island, Secure Folder) instead of asking to use the personal profile (errors 19 and 900009) or opening the web app.

patches.name: Request microG permissions
patches.description: Asks for account access and microG extended access when Gemini starts, so signing in works without granting them manually.

patches.name: Skip uncertified device warning
patches.description: Skips the local "device is not Play Protect certified" screen that the bundled Google Play services client shows with microG. Does not change any device or server certification state.

patches.name: Unlock update-required chats
patches.description: Keeps the input field and hides the "Update required for this conversation" card ("App aktualisieren") that the server shows for some chats. The patched app cannot be updated from the Play Store, so this card would otherwise block these chats for good.

patches.name: microG support
patches.description: Installs the Google app as a separate clone that signs in with microG (app.revanced.android.gms) instead of Google Play services. microG must be installed in the same profile.
